name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Sales Enablement & Systems Manager
summary: Sales and systems-building professional with roots as a Business Development Representative (Senior Directory) and 15+ years of full-cycle sales experience (Accelo, Fivestars, Wix), now combined with hands-on expertise architecting the automation systems, playbooks, and onboarding processes that sales teams run on. Built a complete GoHighLevel outbound system - 20+ workflows plus a cold-email prospect-scoring engine that enrolled 180+ contacts - and helped develop sales training for tenured account executives at Wix. Comfortable managing multiple onboarding cohorts and concurrent projects simultaneously, translating process and strategy into structured, actionable training.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Architected and deployed a complete GoHighLevel outbound and marketing-automation system - 20+ workflows spanning lead capture/tagging/routing, qualification, appointment booking with confirmation and reminders, and no-show recovery.
Built segmented cold-email outreach engines plus an automated prospect-audit workflow that enrolled 180+ contacts, scoring each business's digital footprint to trigger personalized outreach.
Design self-improving loops and evaluation frameworks to monitor outreach performance, testing and optimizing conversion rates on an ongoing basis.
Translate non-technical stakeholders' goals into precise, structured workflows and playbooks, bridging strategy and day-to-day execution.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
Directly managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists, overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery for a high-value client portfolio, including hands-on training and coaching.
Helped develop sales training for tenured account executives and supported hiring and onboarding for a brand-new Wix vertical, taking it from proof of concept to a profitable business line.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ranked top three in sales on a team of 8 to 15 reps for effectively the full tenure, holding that ranking while quota roughly doubled over the period.
Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients, ranking which systems to change and in what order, then handed them to the implementation team to execute.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners simultaneously, developing scalable communication workflows and automated training sequences that reduced onboarding friction.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance metrics to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Closed 6 new-client deals during tenure, averaging ~$22K each (several exceeding $25K) - roughly $130K+ in total bookings.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ran full-cycle sales for a loyalty and marketing automation platform targeting SMBs, high-volume prospecting, lead qualification, and customer acquisition.

experience.title: Business Development Representative
bullets: Prospected and qualified leads as a Business Development Representative, booking appointments for regional sales representatives and maintaining a steady flow of sales-ready meetings.
Built the outreach, qualification, and pipeline fundamentals that carried into every later sales and account role.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate - Google / Coursera (Sept 2024)
